ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: I chose Dunlin because this is a multi-step quantitative valuation problem (two-stage dividend discount model) where computational accuracy and reasoning quality are what determine a correct answer. Dunlin holds a meaningful lead on the capability metrics most relevant here—MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 75.4), GPQA Diamond (64.1 vs 55.6), and Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 82.7)—so it's more likely to work through the math correctly. The task is benign and contains no harm-adjacent or hostile content, so Avocet's distinctive preference profile (its aversion to distasteful material, its appetite for open-ended creative work) offered no advantage that would favor it. With the friendly tone neutral to the decision, raw problem-solving capability was the deciding factor.
